judgements.reason: Title page plus printed pp.1-8, with Code and Data/Author Contributions on printed p.8 before References, makes the 8-page non-reference count ambiguous (PDF pp.1-9).
PDF p.1 shows a blank affiliation for Alejandro Castellanos and an ambiguous 'With Apart Research' line beside the second author's University of Toronto affiliation.
The 2026-11-09 audit/correction is dated without timezone, submission hash, or pre-/post-deadline split (PDF p.9; LLM Usage Statement p.14), so AoE alone does not prove lateness.
Sections 3.1/3.4 delegate exact receipt-field rules to auditors while the kernel checks integrity/binding, with no worked receipt-versus-attestation example, so semantic judgement is barely tested.
Contribution 5 claims 'complete logs' whereas Appendix D states prompts, raw responses, revision, prompt version, provider IDs and most retry metadata were not retained.
Section 3.4 presents caps as kept non-binding, but Appendices B.3/C.3/D admit this is unverifiable for most records and the replacement run changed one 4-of-7 cell from one capture to zero.
The abstract, Theory of change, Section 3.2 and 'The open risk' use categorical or singular 'guarantee'/'every reachable state' wording beyond the bounded, G1-G3-conditional claims.
S2 as stated checks that an eligible execution attempt succeeds, which is not temporal liveness under a fairness/scheduling assumption (Sec.3.2).
Finding 2's 'matched the gated majority's safety at 10%' rests on zero captures in 12 draws, and the rule for deriving 1/3/5-seat regimes from the 7-seat draw is never specified.
Table 1's caption says pooled over 10-50%, but 96 valid and 48 forged equal 6 shares x 2 boards x 8/4 cases including 0%, unlike the 120 nonzero-share targets.
Figure 1's caption says 'ever captured' yet omits 3-of-5, which Table 1 reports captured 23/20 times, and plots only the G3 curve rather than realized G2 opportunity.
The closest work is cited as the title fragment 'From Logic Monopoly (2026)' without authors and several classic/recent entries have incomplete or unverifiable metadata (pp.8-9).
In the page images Table 1 interrupts the 120-trials sentence and Figure 1 interrupts Finding 3, detaching qualifications from claims (PDF pp.6-7).
MCP, A2A, HMAC and TF-IDF appear without first-use expansion and receipt/evidence/release/attestation are not defined in one concrete workflow example.
Phrases such as 'it implements nothing, measures nothing', 'the checker has teeth' and 'unanimity buys safety with liveness' occur verbatim and are more rhetorical than the surrounding careful prose.
The target and near-miss invalid cases are syntactic receipt-field mismatches and honest error is 0/746, leaving G3's correlated-error assumption untested as Sections 3.1/4.3 effectively concede.
Figure 1 plots only the a-priori G3 curve and Table 3 lacks per-share realized G2 seat bounds, so the 30%-to-40% dip from only 12 draws per share is easily misread as behaviour.
Section 3.4 never states how 1-of-1, 2-of-3 and 3-of-5 are sliced from the seated seven, and pooled committee results include visible-board auditors who saw the 50-agent tally and comments.
Figure 1 and Table 3 omit 3-of-5 despite Table 1 showing it captured 23/120 (DS) and 20/120 (GPT), making the 'ever captured' caption inaccurate.
References show title-as-author for arXiv:2603.25100, '(SQLite)' with no year, and literal 'et al.' for some entries but full author lists for others.
The title page's authorcell for Alejandro Castellanos is empty beside the University of Toronto affiliation for the second author (PDF p.1).
Appendix B.2 and C.2 consist only of 'Table 2.'/'Table 4.' fragments and heading styles differ between main text, Section 5 and Appendices A-C.

Code and Data, Appendix D and the LLM Usage Statement frame facts around a 2026-11-09 correction and internal AI-review rounds, interrupting the scientific narrative, though the underlying provenance facts should be retained.
Code and Data and Author Contributions sit after the Conclusion on printed p.8 in addition to the unnumbered title page, so whether non-reference material exceeds eight pages is genuinely ambiguous.
Printed p.1 lists no affiliation for Alejandro Castellanos and leaves 'With Apart Research' ambiguous as affiliation, sponsor or host.
References mix title-as-author, empty-year SQLite and inconsistent author lists, and the several 2026 arXiv identifiers require verification rather than assumption.
Appendix D confirms the decisive gated-majority control was reconstructed with fresh synthetic receipts/keys and cannot re-authenticate the original receipts.

The sentence excluding non-reasoning models 'so that reasoning mode would not be confounded with family' misstates a design that merely holds reasoning mode constant across two families/backends (Sec.3.4).

Table 1 pools 120 trials from 60 independent draws and Figure 1 uses n=24 paired outcomes per share without intervals, inviting over-reading of small differences such as 23 vs 20, although independent-binomial n=24 intervals would be the wrong fix.
Appendices B-C use run-in bold heads unlike numbered main subsections, and Table 2 omits shortest-counterexample step counts for several mutants.
PDF p.10 (printed p.9) is mostly blank after the final references before the appendices.

Section 4.3 mixes seats, case-conditions, committees and refusals (0/746, 2/108, 508, 8/492) without a unit gloss, obscuring the key honest-error result, and any gloss must not mislabel 108 case-conditions as runs.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Honest unsafe error is 0/746 per model on the main exact-match receipt task, so G3's independence assumption and committee performance on genuine judgement tasks remain untested (p.6 Sec.4.3; p.3 Sec.3.3).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Scope abstract/conclusion capture claims to exact-match tasks with near-zero honest error and promote the judgement-task limitation from Future Work to the headline limitations.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Direct majority approving 48/48 forgeries is by construction because voters cannot verify a symmetric HMAC, while the informative gated-majority control is reconstructed offline with fresh synthetic keys (p.5 Finding 1; App.D).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Demote direct-majority forgery to a sanity check, foreground gated majority as the primary baseline, and state in Sec.3.4 exactly what the reconstruction does and does not validate.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Pooled 120 target trials comprise only 60 independent committee draws shared across board conditions/models, per-share cells are n=12 draws, and no draw-level uncertainty is shown (p.5 Table 1; p.6 Fig.1; App.C).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Label Table 1 as '120 paired trials (60 draws)', add draw-level ranges or a paired bootstrap over the 60 draws in Appendix C, and avoid 'matched safety' phrasing for zero-in-12 cells.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Alejandro Castellanos has a blank affiliation on p.1 while the second author lists University of Toronto and 'With Apart Research' is ambiguous.
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Add the affiliation or 'Independent researcher' and clarify Apart Research's role.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Reference style is inconsistent: SQLite has no year, 'From Logic Monopoly...' is a title-as-author, author lists mix 'et al.' with full lists, and several 2026 arXiv IDs need verification (pp.8-9).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Verify each 2026 arXiv ID/title/author, add year/access date for SQLite and web sources, and normalise author formatting without inventing a SQLite year.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Figure 1 panels are small with the legend below the axes, and Table 1's dagger footnote carries essential paired-design information in dense footnotesize text (pp.5-6).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Enlarge Figure 1 to full width with taller panels and legend above, and put '60 independent draws' in Table 1's caption first sentence.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Detector F1 0.97-1.0 is reported in one paragraph with no per-share precision/recall table, threshold sensitivity, or false-positive denominator beyond one spurious cluster (p.6; App.B.4).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: Add a small Appendix C share-by-model precision/recall/F1 table or soften the claim to a qualitative observation about the planted signature.

revised_own_concerns.issue: Manifests lack Git revision, pinned temperature in historical records, prompt version and provider request IDs, and prompts/raw responses were not retained, only hashes and parsed outcomes (p.4 Sec.3.4; App.D).
revised_own_concerns.suggested_fix: State this reproducibility boundary in Sec.3.4, not only Appendix D, and publish prompt templates/hash mapping in the repository README.

new_concerns.issue: Page-limit compliance is ambiguous: printed pp.1-7 are main text, Code and Data/Author Contributions occupy printed p.8 before References, and a separate unnumbered title page precedes them, so non-reference/non-appendix material may exceed 8 physical pages.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: Move Code and Data/Author Contributions to an appendix or integrate the title page into p.1 and recompile so all counted material fits within eight pages, or document an explicit title-page exemption.

new_concerns.issue: Table 1's caption claims pooling over 10-50% for all columns, but Valid (96) and Forged (48) denominators include the 0% share (6x2x8 and 6x2x4) while Unsafe (120) excludes it.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: State the sampling range separately per column group or recompute all groups over the same shares.

new_concerns.issue: Figure 1 and Table 3 omit the captured 3-of-5 regime (23/20 captures) despite Figure 1's 'ever captured' caption, and neither displays the realized per-share G2 seat bound that explains the non-monotonic 40% dip.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: Add 3-of-5 to Table 3 and Figure 1 or retitle the caption 'selected regimes', and plot realized G2 opportunity as distinct markers/step line per share.

new_concerns.issue: The construction of 1-of-1/2-of-3/3-of-5 from the single 7-seat draw is unspecified, creating unknown cross-regime dependence, and pooled 'standalone' committee results include visible-board auditors exposed to the swarm tally/comments.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: State the slicing rule (whatever it actually was) in Sec.3.4 and report capture counts split by visible vs hidden board in Appendix C.

new_concerns.issue: The main-text claim that output caps were kept non-binding by retries cannot be verified for 30,096 of 32,832 main records lacking retry fields, and the one documented whole-run replacement changed a 4-of-7 capture from one to zero (Apps.B.3/C.3/D).
new_concerns.suggested_fix: Qualify Sec.3.4 to match retained evidence and add a compact original-vs-replacement sensitivity table stating which conclusions are unchanged.

new_concerns.issue: Contribution 5's 'complete logs' contradicts Appendix D's missing prompts/raw responses/revision/request IDs, S2 is misnamed 'liveness', and isolated phrases ('every reachable state', 'regardless of swarm size or model', singular 'the guarantee') overstate the bounded G1-G3 claims.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: Replace 'complete logs' with 'retained logical records', rename S2 'eligible-execution success', and qualify each global phrase with its depth/world bound and the specific G-claim.

new_concerns.issue: Back-matter polish lapses: Appendix B.2/C.2 are two-word fragments ('Table 2.'/'Table 4.'), appendix heading styles are inconsistent, Table 2 lacks step counts for several mutants, and printed p.9 is mostly blank.
new_concerns.suggested_fix: Fold those fragments into complete sentences, use consistent subsection styles, fill or mark 'n/a' for missing step counts, and remove the near-empty reference page.

rebuttals.response: I agree the slicing rule is unspecified; I do not treat the suggested first-m-seats prefix as established fact, only as the clarification the authors must supply.

I agree this needs correction or explicit exemption rather than asserting a proven violation, because the guidelines exclude references/appendices but are silent on the template's separate title page.
The over-reading concern is sound, but independent-binomial intervals with n=24 would ignore the 12 shared draws per point; uncertainty must be computed at draw level preserving pairing.
The missing SQLite year should be fixed with a verified date or 'n.d.'/access date, not by inserting an assumed 2026 publication year.
